blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines has extended for another year the 14-day visa-free entry privilege for Chinese nationals after conducting a review following concerns that it was being exploited by illegal offshore gaming operators and amid heightened tension with Beijing over the South China Sea issue.
